# ADR format

Use the project's decision-record template if one exists, otherwise `docs/adr/ADR-NNN-slug.md`. Scan existing IDs and use the next unused number; never renumber or reuse one.

Include: context, requirement IDs, decision, alternatives, consequences, rollout, verification, authority and status. Keep owner decisions `proposed` until the owner accepts them. Do not infer approval from an agent's recommendation.
